source_refs.title: Turn captions on or off
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To turn on captions, click Closed captions
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer: 1. Open the video you want to watch. 2. Look for the 'Closed captions' (CC) icon at the bottom right of the video player. It appears only if the video has captions. 3. Click the 'Closed captions' icon to turn captions on.

source_refs.title: Turn captions on or off
source_refs.applicability: YouTube app on Android phone or tablet
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Go to the watch page of any video.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone or tablet: 1. Go to the watch page of any video. 2. Tap the player once to reveal the controls, then select 'Closed captions' to enable them. If you don't see 'Closed captions', the video doesn't have captions available.

source_refs.title: Turn captions on or off
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Go to the watch page of any video.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Go to the watch page of any video. 2. Tap the video player once to show the options, then tap 'Closed captions' to turn captions on. If you don't see the 'Closed captions' button, the video doesn't have captions.
